bootstrap.resampling: Resample complete aligned groups and matched run indices independently; use the same group and run multiplicities for every method in a draw.
bootstrap.intervals: Percentile 95% descriptive and 99% Bonferroni for five primary contrasts; no interval is reported if any draw is undefined.

improvement_rule.99_percent_lower_bound: strictly greater than zero for every required contrast

limitations: Bootstrap intervals condition on committed predictions and do not refit models or repeat model selection, evidence discovery, or biological sampling.
